incident-bot: ALERT: paged-kv cache growth detected in prod (us-west-2). Trigger: kv_cache_paged_eviction_rate > 100 for 5m. BlockManager evictions spiked to ~150/s, metadata table size +420% vs baseline. Incident ID INC-1976543210.

Maya R: noticing 99p latency jump on /v1/generate and a bunch of 502/504s. Dashboard: https://dash.re/redwood/kv-cache?range=15m — top queue depth on runtime-proxy-3 pods.

Allen C (oncall): taking pager. Quick questions: is this isolated to a single region? Any customer-facing 5xxs?

Maya R: Mostly us-west-2; a few affected requests from eu-west-1 routed via us-west edge. Customer reports: ACME and finops-ltd reported errors. I can repro high batch_queue_depth on runtime-proxy-3.* pods.

Allen C: first mitigation — throttle continuous batching globally for prod. Can someone flip the feature-flag on the proxy? We want batching disabled for 30m while we triage.

Maya R: running the flag toggle on a canary now. Command used:
```
curl -X POST 'https://config.re/api/flags/continuous_batching' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"enabled":false, "scope":"prod"}'
```
Response: {"status":"ok","applied_to":"us-west-2a-canary"} 

Sasha L (eng-runtime): I've got a hotpatch ready to switch the block manager eviction policy to aggressive_lru (reduce metadata retention) and to increase block_size for hot tenants. Patch: https://git.re/redwood/hotfixes/patch-evict-1976. Snippet of patch config:
```
block_manager:
  eviction_policy: aggressive_lru
  block_size_kb: 128
  metadata_ttl_secs: 300
```

Allen C: before we roll that, let's do a lighter change — reduce batch_size on the runtime layer from 8 -> 2 and shorten the batching-window 50ms -> 10ms. That should drop queue depth immediately. Command: `rctl set runtime.batch_size=2 --env=prod` and `rctl set runtime.batch_ms=10 --env=prod`.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by Allen C: config-change/runtime-batching-throttle -> rolling 6 pods in us-west-2.

Maya R: after throttling batch_size, batch_queue_depth on the hot proxy went from ~120 down to single digits in ~60s. Eviction rate fell from 150/s -> ~22/s. 95p latency for text-gen dropped 620ms -> 180ms. Still seeing some 5xxs for tenant acme-inc.

Customer Support: ticket INC-TCK-9832 created for ACME. CSM notified and engaged; they reported intermittent 5xxs starting 12:33Z.

Sasha L: I'll prepare the hotpatch but we should be careful: increasing block_size reduces metadata pressure but may increase eviction granularity. Plan: apply aggressive_lru globally and target block_size bump only for tenants with high metadata churn (ACME, finops-ltd) via tenant-overrides.

Maya R: adding quick logs for context:
```
2026-03-15T12:34:10Z blockmgr evict=150 mem=92% meta_table_rows=12_400_213 tenant=acme-inc request=/v1/generate
2026-03-15T12:35:02Z batch_queue_depth=112 -> 8 after batching throttle
2026-03-15T12:36:20Z proxy-3 error=502 upstream_timeout tenant=finops-ltd
```

Allen C: I'm rolling the tenant-overrides and the eviction policy patch to the canary group now. If 5m stable -> roll to region. If not, rollback and we keep batching off.

deploy-bot: Hotpatch applied to canary: hotfix/block-evict-v2 -> success on runtime-proxy-3a. Logs: patch_applied=true

Maya R: canary looks good. Evictions down and memory stabilized. Pushing region-wide now.

deploy-bot: Hotpatch rolled to region us-west-2: 4/4 pods updated.

Maya R: after region roll, overall evictions ~18/s, memory at ~68%. 99p latency back to normal for most tenants. ACME still has ~1% elevated errors (most likely backlog).

Allen C: mitigation checklist: 
- batching disabled (global) : done
- batch_size reduced to 2 : done
- eviction policy = aggressive_lru : deployed
- block_size bumped to 128KB for high-churn tenants: deployed as tenant override
- monitor for 30m and assess rollback/perm fix

Customer Support: ACME CSM updated. They requested ETA for full restoration. ETA: within 45m, keeping them posted.

Kevin P: I will take over the pager in 30m. Next steps on my side: monitor for any regression from block_size bump (eviction granularity) and prepare a rollback to previous eviction policy if we see tail latency regress. Also create follow-up tasks for postmortem and a prompt set to detect metadata leaks.

Allen C: handing off to Kevin now. Full runbook note: https://runbooks.re/paged-kv-mitigation. Timeline added to incident ticket. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-1976543210 status updated -> mitigated (P2) ; monitoring. Last update: 1976543415.

Maya R: summary note for postmortem: root cause appears to be a combination of an increase in metadata churn from a customer-side traffic pattern + a latent bug in continuous batching that allowed queue depth to grow unbounded when the block manager hit heavy eviction cycles (feedback loop). Immediate mitigations: batching throttle + eviction policy change. Permanent fixes: patch to batching backpressure, add metadata-table compacting, and a test for blockmanager under metadata churn.

Kevin P: acknowledged. I'll document owner tasks and schedule the postmortem. Leaving batching disabled until the postmortem action items are implemented.

Maya R: adding the log link and alert metrics to the ticket: https://alerts.re/INC-1976543210/metrics

incident-bot: This channel will be archived once the postmortem is filed.
